summary: Iteration 8 — frontend-only validation of the four new admin/support features (Public Contact form, Admin Contact enquiries, Admin/Nav inbox badges, Admin Plans editor with single-popular enforcement, User Support tickets + Admin Support replies) plus regression on /scan and logins. All 19 tested flows PASS. Single-popular constraint is correctly enforced end-to-end (backend + admin UI + /subscription page). Demo left in a clean state: family_pro is the only 'popular' plan and the ephemeral TEST_ plan was archived.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Admin.jsx hub-badges are driven by a fire-and-forget api.get('/admin/inbox/summary') in useEffect with no loading indicator — badges pop in a few hundred ms after mount. Not a bug (nav-admin-badge behaves the same and testing confirmed both settle to correct counts), but consider a subtle skeleton/placeholder on the two hub cards while inbox summary is in-flight.

AdminPlans.reactivate() reuses p.popular unchanged — good; but a reactivated plan that was popular before archival will silently become popular again, potentially producing two popular plans if another one has since been marked. Consider forcing popular=false on reactivate, or having the server re-run the single-popular constraint on any PUT that sets popular=true (which it already does — so this is only a concern if archive/reactivate leaves stale popular flags. Verified in this test that server enforces single-popular on PUT, so effectively safe).
Contact.jsx uses phone: form.phone.trim() || null — fine; keep as-is.
server.py is still ~4k lines (carry-over from iter 7) — split into routers for maintainability. Non-blocking.

On /subscription 'Most popular' chip renders for the popular plan (currently family_pro).
